source.name: Employment Scam Aegean Dataset (EMSCAD)
source.publisher: University of the Aegean dataset, distributed through Kaggle

checks: source SHA-256 and MD5 match the checked EMSCAD snapshot
stratified random 80/20 split yields 3,576 test posts, including 173 fake posts
tuned sentence model threshold 0.10: F1 0.850, recall 0.751, precision 0.98
five-fold mean F1 0.8251 and standard deviation 0.0208
five-fold mean ROC-AUC 0.9859 and standard deviation 0.0030
precision-recall, threshold, keyword, and SHAP charts regenerated from the fixed-seed run
validation.evaluation: random stratified split, not a time-based holdout

evidenceBoundary: Historical labeled postings support offline model comparison only. They do not establish current scam prevalence, production precision/recall, fairness, job seeker outcomes, or performance on future scam language.
